SINCE: JDK1.0
EXTENDS: java.lang.Object
IMPLEMENTS: java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<java.lang.String>, java.util.Map<? extends BObject, ?>

DESCRIPTION:
The String class represents character strings. All string literals in Java
programs, such as &#x22;abc&#x22;, are implemented as instances of this class.
Strings are constant;
